{{Quote|As a practical matter&mdash;as of this morning&mdash;the Senate no longer exists.|[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]|<ref name="ROTS novel" />}}
The '''Sector Governance Decree''' was a proclamation passed by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a short [[Time/Legends|time]] before the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] by installing a new system of [[Sector/Legends|sector]]ial [[Governor/Legends|governor]]ship.

==History==
{{Quote|Palpatine no longer has to worry about controlling the Senate. By placing his own lackeys as governors over every planet in the Republic, he controls our systems directly. He's become a dictator. We made him a dictator.|[[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]]|<ref name="ROTS novel" />}}
With the outbreak of the Clone Wars and the formation of the Grand Army of the Republic, Supreme Chancellor Palpatine implemented the Sector Governance Decree, creating the positions of [[Planetary Governor/Legends|Planetary Governor]] and [[Moff/Legends|Sector Moff]]. These officials oversaw planetary systems and galactic sectors and exerted control over unruly populations, nominally to improve coordination and strengthen defenses against the Separatists.<ref name="TotG">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref>

The decree also gave twenty of the new Moffs responsibility for supporting the Republic's twenty [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Armies]]. These Moffs' military territories, known as [[Oversector/Legends|oversectors]], matched the Sector Armies' sphere of operations.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> 

The expansion of executive authority through the appointment of Moffs further diminished the practical influence of the Galactic Senate.<ref name="TotG" />

The Sector Governance Decree was the final impetus that led several [[Senator/Legends|senators]] to issue the [[Petition of 2000]]. It was possibly considered in response to the scandal following the [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|fall of Duro]]. 

Backed by an increasingly centralized military structure and the authority vested in regional governors, Palpatine ultimately, toward the end of the war, [[Declaration of a New Order|reorganized]] the Galactic Republic into the Galactic Empire and later [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolved]] the Senate.<ref name="TotG" />
